description: The University of Pittsburgh Rowing Club is always looking for new rowers and coxswains! If you have any interest in joining, please fill out this form or send an email to recruiting@pittrowing.com!
Head of the Occoquan: See the Press Release for our race here.
HOSR: See the Press Release for our race here.
Pitt Crew takes on home regatta! Boats entered were: Para Inclusion 2x, Varsity Women: 1V, 2V, and Lightweight 4+, Varsity Men: 8+, 2X, and 1V and 2V 4+, Novice Women 4+, and Mixed Novice 8+.
Upcoming 2027 races: Pittsburgh Indoor Sprints: February 6, Knecht Cup: April 10-11, Dad Vail Regatta: May 7-8, ACRA National Championship Regatta: May 21-23
This past August, Pitt rower Maya Rosenberger headed to Ontario to race at the Royal Canadian Henley Regatta after attending the US Rowing Paralympic Pathways Camp!
Last May, the Pitt Crew Mens 2x and Womens 4+ travelled to Oak Ridge, Tennessee to race at the ACRA National Championship Regatta! For more info, see the ACRAs Press Release.
Last May, Pitt Crew had many good races at the Dad Vails Regatta! For more info, see the Dad Vails Press Release.
Last April, Knecht Cup: Women’s Inclusion 2x: 1st🥇, Women’s Novice 8+: 2nd🥈, Women’s 2-: 3rd🥉. For more info, see the Knecht Cup Press Release.
For 2026 Pitt Day of Giving, we raised over $9000! Thank you so much to everyone who donated!
Pittsburgh 2026 Indoor Sprints: Open Four Person Relay: 2nd🥈 and 3rd🥉, Womens 2k: Alilie in 3rd🥉, Mens 2k: David in 3rd🥉, Womens Lightweight 2k: Anna in 1st🥇, Womens PR2 2k: Maya in 1st🥇
